generalization_scope: task-family-held-out; applications are represented in every split
limitations: One-off and very small vulnerability strata cannot appear in every split.
Reviewed taxonomy labels overlap and are not independent vulnerability classes.

policy.optimizer: deterministic rarity-first assignment plus improving pair swaps

tiny_strata.count_1: record placement; do not claim cross-split representation
tiny_strata.count_2_to_4: balance proportionally when compatible with stronger strata
tiny_strata.count_5_or_more: require at least one example in every split

split_unit: reviewed application and task family; one selected exact version per family
